# Description

Please include a brief summary of the changes, relevant motivation and context.

This change fixes an unintended behavior for EP-only workloads where GEMMs sharded like the following
- activations: `[B("ep"), S, H]`
- weights: `[H, D("ep")]`
will perform an all-gather on the activations. This is not desirable in the EP case as EP computation is intended to be FSDP-style outside of the expert layers, and as a result, we wouldn't expect an activation all-gather.

As a result, if a mesh axis shards both a non-contracting dim of the activations and a non-contracting dim of the weights, we now gather the weights along that axis (as is already done for FSDP). Only the overlapping axes are dropped from compound weight specs, e.g. `("ep", "tp")` -> `"tp"`.

We make an exception for TPSP workloads, since there we expect activations to be gathered on the sequence dimension; TP and TPSP axes are therefore ignored in this gather.

We additionally add tests validating the EP-only behavior, compound weight specs, and that existing TP/TPSP (including collective GEMM) sharding is unchanged.

On an E2E training performance run with DSv4, this change observed an 8% improvement in step time.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

- Fix sharding spec removal so that EP-only workloads have weights gathered instead of activations. Additionally, allow only overlapping axes to be dropped from weight specs.
- Add tests to validate behavior.

# Checklist:

- [x] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [x] The functionality is complete
- [x] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [x] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [x] My changes generate no new warnings
- [x] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [x] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** The PR appears safe to merge; the previous compound-spec failure is fixed.

Summary

Keeps EP activations sharded by gathering overlapping weight axes instead. - GEMM partitioning gathers shared EP axes from weights. Reviews (2) · Last reviewed commit: ["Fix bug in sharding axes logic"](https://github.com/nvidia/transformerengine/commit/3af8d805b7d183bd15d6fe5b80c7be4a14291128) · [Reviewed by Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=greptile_review&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=review_public&utm_content=nvidia/transformerengine)

**Compound sharding repeats an axis** With `fsdp_resource="fsdp"` and `tpsp_resource="tpsp"`, a plain GEMM with input specs `(("fsdp", "tpsp"), None)` and `(None, ("fsdp", "tpsp"))` now keeps `"tpsp"` on the weight. The later activation gather compares whole tuples against individual axes, so it leaves `("fsdp", "tpsp")` unchanged. The resulting output spec, `(("fsdp", "tpsp"), "tpsp")`, repeats an axis across dimensions and fails when building `NamedSharding`. Previously, the whole weight spec was gathered and the output was valid. Remove overlapping axes from compound activation specs too, and add this case to the tests.
